track.audit_prompt: You are an experienced Python developer reviewing practice questions about a small Python code base. Choose the single correct answer. For code, reason about exactly what Python 3.12 would do. Then critique the item as a reviewer: list any other option you consider equally defensible, and note any flaw such as an ambiguous stem, a factual error, or a clue that gives the answer away.

Counter: Re-read check_distribution() in validation/validate.py, which counts answer letters with Counter
Practise what Counter returns for a missing key and what iterating a Counter yields
defaultdict: Explain when a default factory runs and why it must build a new object each time
Dataclasses: Read the Result dataclass at the top of validation/validate.py
Explain why a list field needs field(default_factory=list)
Comprehensions: Rewrite the grid and texts comprehensions in validate.py as plain loops
Compare a dict comprehension with dict.fromkeys when the value is mutable

Regex patterns: Read BANNED_OPTION and NEGATION near the top of validation/validate.py
Practise \b word boundaries, character classes, and re.fullmatch versus re.search
Regex flags and matches: Explain what re.I changes and what a match object's span() returns
Trace the negation-emphasis check in check_content()
String formatting: Practise f-string format specs such as :.1% and :.2f, and doubled braces
Read the report lines built in render_report()

Paths: Read rel() in validation/validate.py and the pathlib parts it uses
Practise name, stem, suffix, and relative_to on PurePosixPath
JSON: Read load_json() in validate.py and load_questions() in validation/audit.py
Predict the Python types json.loads returns
Exceptions: Explain which errors load_json() catches and why it records them instead of stopping
Practise exception subclasses such as json.JSONDecodeError and ValueError
CSV: Explain csv.DictWriter and why CSV files are opened with newline=""

Type hints: Read the signatures of load_bank() and run_checks() in validation/validate.py
Explain what from __future__ import annotations changes
argparse: Read main() in validate.py and audit.py
Script structure: Trace how main() turns failures and --strict into an exit code
Sorting and keys: Practise sorted() with key functions and reverse=True
Explain how Python compares lists and tuples element by element

TF-IDF: Read tokenize() and tfidf() in validation/validate.py
Work out a smoothed IDF and an L2-normalised vector by hand
Cosine similarity: Read similar_pairs() and explain what the postings lists save
Compute a dot product of two sparse vectors stored as dicts
Largest-remainder allocation: Read allocate() in validate.py and core.js
Show why rounding each share separately can miss the total

Secrets and configuration: Read how main() in validation/audit.py checks ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Explain why keys belong in environment variables or a secrets store, never in the repository
Errors and retries: Read the except chain in audit_sync() and why the most specific error comes first
Explain the retry-after header and resumable caching
Batch processing: Read audit_batch() and its polling loop
Explain why batch results are matched by custom_id
Model output: Read parse_message() and question_prompt() in audit.py
Explain why the audit never shows the model the answer key
